description: Indicative price range (SGD) for an HDB resale flat, computed from recent registered resale transactions (data.gov.sg, Singapore Open Data Licence). Returns an estimate, a 25th-75th percentile range, the most similar recent sales, and notes. No token needed. Backtest: median error about 5% on unseen sales, versus about 9% for a plain town-and-type median. A statistical estimate, not a valuation. Free tier: 30 calls per caller per day.
name: hdb_fair_value
title: Estimate fair value of a Singapore HDB resale flat
